title: Uniform geometric coordinate difference with smaller support
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X a proper k-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism], F a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and d a natural number with dim Supp(F)≤d+1 [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let L_i, i in Fin r, be invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module], and j in Fin r. Write chi_n(M) for chi(X,M tensor the integer powers L_i^(n_i)), folded in order [def-pc-euler-characteristic]. There are a natural number m, coherent modules G_a on X with dim Supp(G_a)≤d, and integers c_a, independent of n, such that chi_(n+e_j)(F)-chi_n(F)=sum_(a in Fin m)c_a chi_n(G_a) for every integer vector n.

proof.text: Write chi_n(M) for the Euler characteristic after the list-fold tensor twist. If dim Supp(F)≤d, use G_0=F tensor L_j, G_1=F and signs +1,-1. Invertible tensoring preserves coherent modules and their support, and associativity, symmetry and dual evaluation give chi_(n+e_j)(F)=chi_n(F tensor L_j). The empty-support case can also use the empty sum.

Otherwise the finite dimension of Supp(F) is d+1. Remove embedded points by [lem-sc-hilbert-embedded-points], giving 0→K→F→Fprime→0 and dim Supp(K)≤d. Take the scheme-theoretic support i:Z→X of Fprime and its coherent module H via [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-theoretic-support] and [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-coherent-equivalence]. It is faithful with support Z. The local embedding O_Z into a finite sum of copies of H implies Ass(O_Z)⊆Ass(H), hence Z has no embedded points. It is proper, Noetherian, nonempty and of dimension d+1.

Choose a regular meromorphic section of i^*L_j by [lem-sc-regular-meromorphic-section-exists] and apply [lem-sc-hilbert-difference] to H itself. Keep its two monomorphisms from the denominator product and their coherent cokernels Q,Qprime, with supports of dimension≤d. These modules and maps are chosen before n. Tensor both exact sequences by all pulled-back integer powers; their invertibility gives exactness. Subtract Euler additivity: the coordinate difference is chi_n(Qprime)-chi_n(Q), uniformly in every coordinate, not just on a chosen one-dimensional slice.

Push these two cokernels to X. Closed-immersion cohomology and projection formula identify all twisted Euler characteristics; closed embeddings preserve the dimensions of their supports. Tensor 0→K→F→Fprime→0 by the same powers and subtract its Euler identities at n+e_j and n. The additional contribution is chi_n(K tensor L_j)-chi_n(K). Thus use four sheaves i_*Qprime,i_*Q,K tensor L_j,K, signs +1,-1,+1,-1; each is coherent and has support dimension≤d.

theorem eulerChar_tensorPowers_coordinate_difference
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} ≤
      ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (r : ℕ) (L : Fin r → X.Modules) [∀ i : Fin r, (L i).IsInvertible]
    (j : Fin r) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : Fin m → X.Modules) (c : Fin m → ℤ),
      (∀ i, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (G i)) ∧
      (∀ i, topologicalKrullDim {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton ((G i).presheaf.stalk x)} ≤
        (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧
      ∀ n : Fin r → ℤ,
        (((List.ofFn fun i : Fin r =>
          if 0 ≤ Function.update n j (n j + 1) i then
            (L i).tensorPow (Function.update n j (n j + 1) i).toNat
          else (L i).dual.tensorPow (-Function.update n j (n j + 1) i).toNat).foldl
            (fun M N : X.Modules => M ⊗ N) F).eulerChar k) -
        (((List.ofFn fun i : Fin r =>
          if 0 ≤ n i then (L i).tensorPow (n i).toNat
          else (L i).dual.tensorPow (-n i).toNat).foldl
            (fun M N : X.Modules => M ⊗ N) F).eulerChar k) =
        ∑ a : Fin m, c a *
          (((List.ofFn fun i : Fin r =>
            if 0 ≤ n i then (L i).tensorPow (n i).toNat
            else (L i).dual.tensorPow (-n i).toNat).foldl
              (fun M N : X.Modules => M ⊗ N) (G a)).eulerChar k)
